act_descr: - Chapter 1 [+]: Stranded by a 2 a.m. fire alarm at Meyer Green, Ines and Ishita split a Coupa coupon, compare calendars, and walk residents back to EVGR together.
chapters: Mateo scrapes RA data for his bot, Zadie confronts him, Ines refuses to help, and Ishita stays late fixing mislabeled imaging files to keep her spot.
Carlos teaches Ines knife skills and clocks her out on time, while Yifan walks Ishita through a clean CPT plan and drafts her supervisor letter.
A financial‑aid “verification” flags Ines’s remittances and eats her week, Farzaneh’s 1 a.m. Slack lights up, and Ishita gets a nosebleed waiting in the CAPS N95 line.
Ines ships a tidy helpdesk script that stops a dorm Wi‑Fi loop, Ishita lands her first clean imaging run, and they celebrate with extra meal swipes at Arrillaga.
Wildfire smoke cancels classes as Mateo launches the dorm bot anyway, Naomi starts asking lab–startup money questions, and Farzaneh warns the team to keep edits off email.
During the atmospheric river, Ishita ignores building alarms to carry organoid plates upstairs and saves the run, and Ines bikes over with dry ice to keep the imaging queue alive. [+]
Farzaneh hands Ishita a “preprocessing” script to brighten the Nature figure while Omar flags missing controls in lab meeting and gets iced out of the Slack thread. [-]
Ines ships an ethics-audit script that lets Naomi link a grant number to Farzaneh’s stealth-equity filing, and they screenshot timestamps before anyone can revoke access. [+]
Arjun pings Ishita on Signal with a “CPT‑compatible” role and no HR, while Yifan shows her the clause that would burn future consular renewals and she still says “maybe.” [-]
Carlos leads a dining walkout that feeds students with donated burritos on Meyer Green, and Ines and Ishita hand out foil trays side by side until midnight. [+]
Financial‑aid “review” freezes Ines’s refund so she sleeps in Domingos’s shop office and showers at Arrillaga before a double shift, then takes Mateo’s under‑the‑table coding gig. [-]
After spotting his A/B tests on residents’ mental‑health telemetry, Ines exports proof, returns the cash, and walks out, and Zadie forwards the receipts to Naomi. [+]

Naomi publishes tying lab edits to startup cap tables; Dean Klein convenes a containment task force, Farzaneh calls it “miscommunication,” Zadie breaks down and finally checks into Vaden as Ishita’s nosebleed stains her mask. [-]
The paper is accepted and Asha drills Ishita through a precise, documented refusal to the “methods tweak.”
Farzaneh pings at 1 a.m. demanding Ishita’s sign‑off and hinting her letters will vanish.
Naomi leaks emails proving the integrity dashboard repackaged Ines’s prototype with her timestamps intact.
Dean Klein offers a backroom credit while legal warns Ines speaking up could jeopardize her aid and jobs.
Omar files the formal complaint with Slack timestamps, and Ishita attaches her written refusal.
At Coupa, Ines calls it fraud and Ishita calls it survival, and they walk out in opposite directions under Hoover’s shadow.
Ines goes on‑record with Naomi and declines Klein’s committee seat.
Arjun ghosts after dangling day‑1 CPT, and Priyanka and Sanjay press Ishita to keep quiet for the visa.
Zadie returns from Vaden rested and sets boundary hours, while Carlos organizes free meals during a union action.
Layoffs wipe “safe” internships and OPT scrutiny snarls classmates at customs as Yifan warns Ishita to avoid Arjun’s trail.
Commencement under smoke; Ishita starts a vetted STEM OPT job and Ines leaves the Valley, then they meet at Terman Fountain and compare calendars like a truce.
